text: The following question stood in the name of  Mr Kok Heng Leun –  12  To ask	the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) what is the outcome of the investigation into the request from NTU to food court operators to replace bilingual signboards with English-only signages.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
text: asked	the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) with regard to the perceived bias against the use of Chinese characters on the signboard of food stalls at a local university, what are the lessons and steps to prevent a similar occurrence in local tertiary educational institutions.

speaker: Asst Prof Mahdev Mohan (Nominated Member)
text: On behalf of Mr Kok, Question No 12, please.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: (In Mandarin):   I would like to thank the Minister for the clarification.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: According to the newspaper report, it seems that as early as one year ago, NTU has started to ban Chinese characters on the signboard at their food court even though the stalls are selling Chinese food.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: During the Chinese New Year, NTU also prohibits playing of Chinese New Year songs.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: Therefore, I would like to ask the Minister whether the particular NTU staff was the only one responsible for this episode or was he just the scapegoat.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: We know Rome was not built in a day.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: Similarly, this situation did not appear to arise within a short timeframe.

speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
text: (In Mandarin):   Mr Speaker, I think what Mr Ang is trying to refer to is actually the study of Chinese and Chinese culture.

speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
text: Otherwise, he would not have said if this was the tip of the iceberg.

speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
text: Indeed, this is a significant and longstanding issue.

speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
text: If the House were to debate this issue, it may take a few days.

speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
text: I have read the investigation report provided by NTU, and I believe that it is, indeed, an administrative error by one staff.

speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
text: NTU takes this very seriously and has since informed all the vendors of the mistake.
